summary: A mayor wins by a few dozen votes, a hand recount confirms the win, and the loser considers court.
realLife: In Lawrence, Massachusetts in 2013, a challenger led the mayor by 58 votes on election night, and after a hand count of more than 15,000 ballots the lead was 81 votes. The loser protested four ballots and did not concede right away. In Roanoke in 2024 a recount cut a 59-vote lead to 29 and the loser dropped his challenge.
